desc:
🎿 POWDER RUSH 🎿
Powder Rush is a competitive skiing game where you ski down an endless mountain! 
Ski down an endless mountain as you progress through the different summits in the world of Powder Rush.

❄️ 12 Summits, progress through different scenery and environments.
🌀 Spin, flip and ride switch for bonus coins. Launch off the rare MEGA RAMP!
🏔️ Ski through themed tunnels, slalom gates, moguls and glades
🐉 Collect companions that ride with you and drop loot.
✨ Unlock skins with their own poses and trails, plus several skis
⚡ Upgrade your gear and drink potions for boosts
🏁 Ski Races and Summit Hikes every few minutes
🏆 Countless achievements, quests, titles and global leaderboards
🎁 Daily rewards, plus free gifts the longer you play

🔑 CODES: POWDER • FRESHTRACKS • RELEASE

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite so you don't miss an update!!!
